text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during an extended period of
intense
training, Super Creek
approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Did you know Tamtam is growing
vegetables?
Want to take a little break
and go have a look?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you have so many different types
of
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pretty cool, yeah? The li'l runts saved
their
allowances and sent me the seeds.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my li'l siblings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They say I'll get real fast if I eat a
buncha tasty
veggies.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But it takes 'em forever to grow. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You look like you're enjoying
yourself,
Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, ya know. I'll let y'all eat
some too
when they get nice and big!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after visiting Tamamo Cross's

vegetable patch, Super Creek and I are
discussing
training, when...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man... I used fertilizer and everythin'...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey. You guys want somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are your vegetables not doing well?
choice_data_list_en: Did you just say something about fertilizer...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh... Heh. Yeah, well, it's no biggie.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll figure somethin' out! No worries!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Tamtam? Why don't we look into
it
together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whatcha mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya seriously don't need ta worry 'bout it.
I bet
you're all busy and stuff.
choice_data_list: 野菜を元気にする方法！
choice_data_list_en: How to perk up the vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And it's not like we got a pro veggie
grower
'round here just readily available
ta help us. It's
not somethin' ya can
easily look up either, so it'd
be a waste
of ti—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And it's not like we got a pro veggie
grower
'round here just readily available
ta help us. It's
not somethin' ya can
easily look up either, so it'd
be a waste
of ti—
choice_data_list: 詳しい人ならいるはずだ
詳しい人ならいるはずだよ
みんなで調べればすぐだ
みんなで調べればすぐだよ
choice_data_list_en: There's bound to be someone who knows.
I'm sure there's someone who knows.
It won't take long if we all look into it together.
It'll be quick if we all look into it together!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Oh, what about Flower?
Why don't
we go and ask her?
choice_data_list: 詳しい人ならいるはずだ
詳しい人ならいるはずだよ
みんなで調べればすぐだ
みんなで調べればすぐだよ
choice_data_list_en: There's bound to be someone who knows.
I'm sure there's someone who knows.
It won't take long if we all look into it together.
It'll be quick if we all look into it together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Flower? Ya mean Nishino Flower?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya don't gotta come along. I can go and
ask
myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think it'd be best if we all
pepped these
veggies up together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You, Trainer, and me! Let's go shower
them with
affection!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everything shines more brightly when
raised with
lots of love.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
L-love? I dunno how ya say such
embarrassin'
things with a straight face...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a buncha veggies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know you don't see them that
way.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just the vegetables that I
want to
shower with love.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My adorable little Tamtam! I want to
smother you
with affection too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-hell no! Your affection's way too
sweet!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, look at you getting all
embarrassed.
Adorable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek smiles at the sight of
Tamamo
Cross's flushed cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Listen. Yer gettin' too caught up in my
business.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you postponin' your trainin'
just to
help me out.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... Did you hear that, Trainer?
What do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I agree!
choice_data_list: それはそれ、これはこれ
choice_data_list_en: That's that, and this is this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That don't make sense! The hell ya
sayin'?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You may as well give in to the
inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
While training is important, we can
always make
up the lost time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But vegetables are living things. Let's all
work
together to save them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nnh...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Their lives were a precious gift from
someone
special. Right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry, and thanks for the help!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Glad to be of service! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek smiles in response to
Tamamo
Cross's words of gratitude.
